title: Studio flow edge inspector: on a read-only package the edge controls are disabled with no reason, and the readOnlyReason its host hands it after #28985 is ignored
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from the #28985 os-dev-report (PR #29073, report 6571078597) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** On a read-only package, an administrator who selects a flow **edge** (not a node) in Studio sees every edge control greyed with no reason on hover, on keyboard focus or to assistive tech. #28985 fixes the same defect for the node inspector; the edge inspector sits beside it on the same canvas and is left behind, so `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` still fails on that surface.

**Measured (`origin/main` `6b3ba82cbb`, source reading; NOT MEASURED at a public door).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowEdgeInspector.tsx:223,232,239,270,287,348,370`: each control is `disabled={readOnly}`, with no `aria-describedby`, `title` or focusable described wrapper.
- PR #29073 adds `readOnlyReason?: string` to `MetadataInspectorProps` and Studio's flow host passes it when `editLocked`. `FlowEdgeInspector` receives the same props and ignores it.

**Wanted.**
1. When `readOnly && readOnlyReason`, the edge inspector draws the same focusable, `aria-describedby` reason group as `FlowNodeInspector` after #28985, on hover, on keyboard focus and to assistive tech.
2. Hosts that pass no reason are unchanged. No new key or option.

**Tests.** A read-only edge with a reason: the disabled controls are described and the group is focusable. Without a reason: unchanged. A test that fails on `main`.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`. Size S. Waits for PR #29073 (#28985) to land, since it reads the prop that PR adds.

**Dedupe.** Searched `FlowEdgeInspector`, `flow edge inspector disabled reason`: only #28985.

Links back: #28985, PR #29073.
